description:
A ballast box can protect your tractor from tipping over. It improves traction by balancing and shifting weight from the weaker front end of the device to the stronger back end.
Fitment
Fits 3-point category 1 tractor and skid steers.
Fits for a 2" hitch ball receiver. (Hitch ball receiver is not included)
Widely used in heavy-duty work of industrial, agricultural, and construction businesses. With 800 lbs capacity, it can be used on various occasions.
Please do not abuse, misuse or overload the use of this product.
For your safety, professional installation is recommended.
Features
Durable Material:
The ballast box is made from heavy duty, sturdy steel optimized for
long-lasting durability; Its strong gloss green powder coated finish
prevents corrosion and rusting.
Unique Design: Lower lift pin and top link pin facilitate easy
installation; You can fill the 3 point hitch ballast box with concrete,
sand, steel, gravel, or rock to add weight and stability to the tractor;
Also equipped with a sliding front door for easy open and emptying the
box when weight reduction is required.
3 Point CAT 1: This tractor ballast box is designed to fit 3-point
Category 1 tractor and compatible with a wide variety of different makes
and models; Make sure you have the suitable machine model before
purchase.
Wide Application: The 3 point ballast box can be used to increase the
weight of a three-point machine and improve stability; Can also be used
for tool storage with a pair of integrated tube holders; Great for any
agricultural work.
Specifications: Volume: 5.3 cubic meters; Ballast box dimensions: 27"L x
16" W x 26"H; Fork pockets are 6’’; Knife holder pocket diameter: 3";
Bottom to bottom lift pin center length is 8"; Weight of 103.62lbs.;
Material: Steel; Capacity: 800 lbs.
